Success(0).note: error zeroed; applySolution writes back (FreeCAD Sketch.cpp:4823)

Converged(1).note: minimized without zeroing — treated as failure by FreeCAD's contract (no write-back)

solve_status_vocabulary.chain: DogLeg -> BFGS -> LevenbergMarquardt -> SQP-augmented (Sketch.cpp:4795-4905 verbatim; the 4th step pins every parameter to its current value via temporary equalities)

value_mutation.api: constraint datums are caller-owned plain double* — set the value, initSolution(), solve() (no rebuild of the object graph); verified by the mutation-path checks in triangle_value_edit / circle_radius_only_edit / the staircase edit at N=200
value_mutation.contrast: slvs has NO mutation API (m3-eval rejection pillar 2); SolidCraft has set_value + solve_after_value_edit with continuation substeps

api_surface.diagnostics: dofsNumber() + getConflicting/getRedundant/getPartiallyRedundant (TAGS — the label mapping is caller-owned) + getDependentParams (GCS.h:608-651); diagnose runs inside initSolution (GCS.cpp:1731-1737)
api_surface.diagnose_caveats: diagnose outcomes are formulation- and order-dependent for degenerate/redundant systems — demonstrated by the slot formulation_probes: the same fixture yields dof 0 (AngleViaPoint form, constraint-addition order A) vs dof 2 + 4 flagged (P2LDistance form) vs dof 4 + 10 flagged (corpus order); rank itself should be read from the structurally-clean probe, and the solver's own report recorded as-is per formulation
api_surface.failure_semantics: copy-solve + applySolution only on Success = bitwise restore on failure (reference/undoSolution, GCS.cpp:1849-1888) — verified by every failure case

cases.notes: HONEST FAILURE RECORD: SolveSpace's exposed path fails exactly-redundant systems (probe-verified: duplicate V and duplicate H variants both return flag 1; a trivial duplicate-Horizontal on a single line returns OKAY with dof 2 — not the rank-accurate 3). CAD Sketcher itself treats implied redundancy as a failure mode to engineer around: curve_solver.py:335-352 (issue #674) — 'Submitting them consumes a DOF and, when the quantity is already implied, forces REDUNDANT_OK and flags the group failed' — and gates reference dimensions out of the system; its UI does define a REDUNDANT_OK info state (global_data.py:96-105). SolidCraft solves the same fixture and names the duplicate (TL2 redundant=['k8']).
